Streams `application/x-ndjson` progress using the pull event shape: `begin`, one `blob` per blob
(`cached: true` when the registry already has it), `blob_done`, `manifest`, then `done` (with `digest`)
or `error`. Authentication follows the registry challenge (Bearer or Basic); loopback registries
(localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1) use plain HTTP. See docs/images.md.
